summary: Report exec index/lastIndex/d-indices in UTF-16 code units even under Unicode matching modes.

target.notes: u/v matching can operate on code points internally, but observable match positions are converted back to ECMAScript String indices measured in UTF-16 code units.

caveats: C# string indices are also UTF-16, but matching-engine boundaries and Unicode grammar still must follow ECMAScript.

tests.name: astral match starts after one code unit char
global lastIndex counts surrogate pair as two code units
